subject: A warming record
one_idea: Thirty years of annual global surface temperature drawn as a rising line of marks on cream paper; the axis grows, the marks land in order, and the record's warmest year is ringed and named.
facts: The series is the annual mean global surface-temperature anomaly for the 30 years 1996-2025.
The 1996 annual mean was +0.33 degrees Celsius above the 1951-1980 mean.
The 2024 annual mean was +1.28 degrees Celsius above the 1951-1980 mean.
2024 was the warmest year in the 30-year record, and 2025 was +1.19 degrees Celsius.
The vertical axis is labelled in degrees Celsius and runs from 0.0 to 1.5, with gridlines at 0.5 and 1.0.
